verdict.rationale: Brevo has a documented public developer API. It covers transactional email, SMS/WhatsApp, contacts, eCommerce, conversations and event tracking, with API-key and OAuth 2.0 M2M authentication, official SDKs, and a Postman workspace. The docs are AI-agent-friendly: a verified llms.txt and Markdown versions of pages. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented for agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Authenticate with an API key, or with OAuth 2.0 — including machine-to-machine (M2M) for server-to-server integrations.
Official SDKs with full API coverage. Available for Node.js, Python, and PHP.
Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
